title.narrative: Projet de renforcement de la capacité opérationnelle Welthungerhilfe face au risque de catastrophes à Madagascar

description.narrative: Objectif général :Assurer une réponse appropriée aux crises alimentaires et nutritionnelles dans les régions d’intervention (Atsimo, Atsinanana et Anosy) tout en stabilisant et en améliorant la sécurité alimentaire et nutritionnelle des participants d’ici la fin du projet.

The project will provide response to food and nutrition crises in Atsimo Atsinanana and Anosy through a multisector approach aimed at achieving food and nutritional security, and building resilience by the end of the project. Complementary and nutrition-sensitive activities, like access to drinking water and improved hygiene practices will support the activities in the areas of food and nutrition. Involving target communities in the decision-making process is an absolute priority in WHH's approach. This approach contributes to higher social acceptance, effective ownership, and relevance and effectiveness of our action. While responding to the crisis, the project will also build up the capacity of the WHH Madagascar emergency team.
